## Rule by liveness model
Which layer a probe must touch depends on the tool's liveness model:

- `needs-traffic` (a store that pauses after idle time, as Supabase does): the keepalive probe must reach the store with a real table read. A probe answered by a cache or by the API layer's schema root leaves the idle timer running while it reports green (issue:fixture-org/tripnote#12, run:fixture-org/tripnote/9182736455; trace raw:20261101T090000Z-1a2b3c4d).
- `needs-silence` (a scale-to-zero store, as Neon is) and `needs-heal` (a reclaimable container): the probe stops at the application, on a store-free `/health/live`, and container healthchecks and keepalives never query the store, so an idle app lets it suspend (commit:fixture-org/ledgerline@4b9e1d27c0a3f58e6d1b2c7a9f0e3d4c5b6a7980, issue:fixture-org/ledgerline#7; trace raw:20261101T091500Z-5e6f7a8b).
- Readiness that does check the store stays on `/health`, which only verify calls at deploy time (commit:fixture-org/ledgerline@4b9e1d27c0a3f58e6d1b2c7a9f0e3d4c5b6a7980).
- Keep all probes off the database, for every tool (commit:fixture-org/ledgerline@4b9e1d27c0a3f58e6d1b2c7a9f0e3d4c5b6a7980, issue:fixture-org/ledgerline#7; trace raw:20261101T091500Z-5e6f7a8b).

## Related
The probe half of this failure is the `needs-silence` branch of pattern/probe-touches-wrong-layer: a healthcheck or keepalive aimed at a store-querying route kept the compute awake (commit:fixture-org/ledgerline@4b9e1d27c0a3f58e6d1b2c7a9f0e3d4c5b6a7980).

# Wiki index

## Patterns
- [keepalive-probe-misses-postgres](patterns/keepalive-probe-misses-postgres.md) — confirmed — a Supabase keepalive that never reaches Postgres.
- [neon-never-sleeps](patterns/neon-never-sleeps.md) — hypothesis — idle-time polling keeps a scale-to-zero compute awake.
- [probe-touches-wrong-layer](patterns/probe-touches-wrong-layer.md) — hypothesis — a probe must touch the layer its liveness model manages: the store for needs-traffic, the application for needs-silence and needs-heal.
append_log: Updated pattern/probe-touches-wrong-layer with a rule conditional on the liveness model, from incident/2026-07-tripnote-keepalive-green-store-paused (needs-traffic: reach the store) and incident/2026-08-ledgerline-store-never-suspends (needs-silence: stop at the application). Linked pattern/neon-never-sleeps to it. Statuses unchanged: no deployed red-to-green evidence for the needs-silence side yet.
